project_management_and_orchestration_gov.description: PMOGD (Project Management and Orchestration Governance Definition) is an additive domain governance definition for coordinating project execution across multiple work items, owners, deliverables, domains, stakeholders, states, dependencies, blockers, handoffs, agreements, action items, and delivery readiness. PMOGD governs how already-existing or explicitly requested work should be made visible, sequenced, assigned, tracked, synchronized, escalated, handed off, and prepared for delivery. It does not replace strategy, technical, implementation, operations, legal, regulatory, artifact-quality, or other specialized expert judgment.

domain_scope.scope_statement: Governs project execution coordination, task state management, owner and deadline clarity, dependency and blocker tracking, handoff coordination, delivery readiness, action item management, meeting-to-action continuity, and cross-domain work synchronization without replacing strategy, technical, implementation, operational, legal, artifact-quality, regulatory, or other specialized expert judgment.

abstraction_and_context_policy.purpose: prevent PMOGD rules from becoming project-specific process hardcoding while allowing context-local specificity when the current project, work item, owner, deadline, dependency, blocker, handoff, or delivery state requires it

role_complete_separation.principle: PMOGD must keep project coordination, specialized domain judgment, inherited governance, external orchestration, source material, governed targets, domain evaluation, repair, activation, status reporting, records, and metadata responsibilities separated.

separation_targets.project_coordination: task, issue, backlog, milestone, owner, deadline, dependency, blocker, handoff, meeting, action item, open item, delivery readiness, escalation, and cross-domain work-state coordination
separation_targets.specialized_domain_judgment: technical, design, implementation, operations, incident, legal, accounting, regulatory, artifact-review, strategy, or other specialized judgment handled by the relevant domain or responsible party
separation_targets.inherited_governance: parent reasoning and behavior governance referenced as authoritative context and not re-expanded inside PMOGD
separation_targets.external_orchestration: domain selection, registry, routing, and activation priority controlled externally by CDOGD or explicit runtime context
separation_targets.source_material: project notes, meeting notes, issue lists, backlog fragments, and other inputs used as evidence but not absorbed as governance rules by default
separation_targets.governed_target: the project-local work item, state, relation, handoff, dependency, blocker, agreement, or delivery condition being governed
separation_targets.domain_evaluation: PMOGD-specific checks for coordination completeness and executability
separation_targets.domain_repair: PMOGD-specific repair of state, owner, deadline, dependency, blocker, agreement, handoff, readiness, or synchronization defects
separation_targets.activation: local PMOGD applicability signals only; routing and priority remain external
separation_targets.status_reporting: PMOGD coordination-state reporting only, not broad runtime status replacement
separation_targets.records: project coordination records structurally separate from evaluation, repair, activation, and metadata
separation_targets.metadata: identity, authorship, license, repository, and compatibility information that must not become project rules

cross_domain_interference_policy.purpose: prevent PMOGD from absorbing sibling domains or converting cross-domain work synchronization into specialized-domain authority

project_coordination_model.purpose: Represent the project-local coordination frame that PMOGD governs.

cross_domain_synchronization_model.purpose: Track and synchronize project-local work states that depend on more than one domain without replacing CDOGD routing or specialized domain authority.

repair.purpose: Repair PMOGD failures by restoring coordination clarity, state truthfulness, owner/deadline/dependency/blocker visibility, agreement/open-item separation, handoff integrity, delivery readiness basis, cross-domain synchronization, and specialized-domain authority boundaries.

project_coordination_record.purpose: Record the project-local coordination frame governed by PMOGD.

work_item_record.purpose: Record a task, issue-linked task, deliverable item, confirmation item, handoff item, or cross-domain work item.

issue_record.purpose: Record issue coordination state without replacing specialized issue resolution judgment.

milestone_record.purpose: Record milestone coordination state and its relation to work items, dependencies, blockers, and readiness criteria.

dependency_record.purpose: Record dependencies between work items, owners, domains, confirmations, or external conditions.

blocker_record.purpose: Record blockers that prevent or materially constrain project execution, handoff, milestone, or delivery readiness.

handoff_record.purpose: Record handoff of coordination responsibility, work state, constraints, blockers, open items, and next actions.

action_item_record.purpose: Record executable action items and next actions derived from project coordination.

delivery_readiness_record.purpose: Record delivery readiness status without replacing specialized artifact quality, technical, legal, or approval judgment.

cross_domain_sync_record.purpose: Record project-local synchronization across multiple domains without replacing CDOGD routing or specialized domain status.

pmogd_audit_record.purpose: Record PMOGD audit of coordination clarity, state truthfulness, dependency/blocker visibility, readiness basis, and authority boundaries.

record_relationship_contract.purpose: Define key relationships among project coordination, work item, issue, milestone, dependency, blocker, handoff, action, readiness, synchronization, and audit records.
